name: GTSDB
description: Vehicle-camera road scenes from around Bochum, Germany, labeled with traffic signs, from the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark. Recorded in spring and autumn 2010 on urban, rural, and highway roads at daytime and dusk in varied weather, with signs labeled in the fine-grained GTSRB taxonomy. Here the official training images are split into train and val; the official test set is kept. Source: Houben, Stallkamp, Salmen, Schlipsing, Igel, "Detection of Traffic Signs in Real-World Images: The German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark," IJCNN 2013; benchmark.ini.rub.de.
